annotations.title: OFAC sanctions check: wallet or name

description: OFAC sanctions check: screen a crypto wallet address (EVM, Bitcoin, Tron and more) or a person or company name against the OFAC SDN list and get a verdict (block, review, pass) with every match, SDN id and program. A screening aid, not legal advice. Use before paying or accepting funds, or when onboarding a counterparty. Example: address=0x098B716B8Aaf21512996dC57EB0615e2383E2f96. Price $0.009/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
